summary.en: Sam turns her dead brother's bodycam back on and walks his last round through the Grands Avaux at dawn. Someone is still on the line.
summary.fr: Sam rallume la caméra-piéton de son frère mort et refait sa dernière tournée dans les Grands Avaux, à l'aube. Quelqu'un est encore en ligne.

battery.note: 14 minutes of battery; transitions cost their cost_s on top of real time

jay.alarm.en: a jay's harsh alarm call, two or three rasps, from the canopy

camera.beep.en: the bodycam's low-battery double beep, close to the microphone

bracken.rustle.en: something heavy moving in dry bracken, ten metres away, then nothing

engine_wanted.what: named viewpoints with transitions between them (v1 frame); the fiche has no place graph
light set per station on arrival (sun height, ground mist), eased over the transition; today only story 'temps' can step soleil/brume
synthesized cues as recipes: bird alarm call, electronic beep, rustle in vegetation; bruitages.json has only two recipes
a second speaker heard off-screen with its own voice and subtitles (the walker)
a person in the frame, even far and blurred
an animal shape that moves (badger at the edge of frame, jay in flight)
a sensor degradation control driven by the battery (noise, dropped frames, colour loss)
the carrier switching the feed off as an ending, with a last frame
a station that sets a seated camera height on arrival
paint on an existing seeded trunk; today a marked trunk must be a separate object made of shapes
objects placed relative to a station rather than by distance along the path
short handwriting on a surface (Louis's board); Sam reads it aloud instead
